comparison.objective: Close a car bonnet until it latches without pressing or slamming it; body and specs are absent.
comparison.physical_skill: Force- and velocity-limited large-panel closure and latch engagement, not tool-mediated impact fracture.
comparison.success_condition: Bonnet is latched with prohibited pressing and slamming avoided; quantitative limits are unavailable.
comparison.reason: Controlled latch closure is a different physical mechanism, even though both penalize excessive impact.
